description: This file defines an asynchronous function 'parseOverrides' that uses TypeScript compiler API to parse a TypeScript/JavaScript source file, traverse its AST, and generate modified source code with inserted comments for class and method declarations.

methods.name: parseOverrides
methods.description: Main function that parses a source file, traverses its AST, and inserts comments for classes and methods based on provided callback functions.

methods.name: getIndentationAtPos
methods.description: Helper function to determine indentation whitespace at a given position in the source file.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Recursive AST visitor that processes class and interface declarations.

methods.name: serializeClass
methods.description: Serializes class or interface nodes by inserting comments and processing class members.

methods.name: visitProperties
methods.description: Traverses property and method signatures within class/interface declarations to insert comments.
